svg.title: Canada study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Okanagan Valley; 2: Niagara Peninsula; 3: Prince Edward County; 4: Annapolis Valley; 5: Eastern Townships; 6: Vancouver; 7: Calgary; 8: Winnipeg; 9: Regina; 10: Thunder Bay; 11: North Bay; 12: Sydney

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
